E0643

`{name}` can't be computed while building: {reason}

What

`{name}` can't be computed while building: {reason}

Why

A module-level `name: value` is computed while building and stored in the program, the same value on every tier. No code runs before `run: fn`, so a value that stops, reaches the outside world, or can't run while building is a build error.

Fix

Compute it in `run` and pass it on; or make it a function, marked `#Memo` when it is pure so the first result is kept; or, for outside data, read a pinned build input such as `comptime { embed_file("config.txt") }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0643: tests/ui/module_shared_cell_starts_from_literal_data.stderr.
